scope: ORL-004 Hostinger queue-only app and PostgreSQL deployment candidate; this is not a full-product completion review
exact_candidate_check: All 16 manifest file SHA-256 values matched the reviewed working files; manifest file SHA-256 matched the supplied identity. Controller-owned .agent state and evidence files are outside this implementation manifest.
repaired_findings: Cloud writes now require exactly one raw Host header, strict DNS hostname syntax, and case-insensitive equality to configured hostname; negative HTTP tests cover path, userinfo, fragment, whitespace, and port variants. Exact Origin comparison remains.

app_password is owned by PostgreSQL Alpine UID/GID 70 with mode 0400; controller reports runtime verification of mount readability and successful fresh init-script role creation with these permissions.
positive_evidence: Cloud configuration requires DB URL, session token, host, and matching HTTPS public origin.
Cloud cookies use random opaque IDs, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, and eight-hour expiry; configured token stays server-side.
App runs as UID 10001 with a read-only root filesystem; PostgreSQL has an internal network and no published port; app joins the existing Traefik network with an explicit router and TLS resolver.
Docker build context excludes secrets; Dockerfile copies migration into runtime image; cloud startup waits for DB readiness and migration before listening.
The Hostinger Compose stack defines only app and db and makes no worker or provider credential available.

validation_boundary.builder_claimed_local_gates: npm ci, typecheck, 14 tests, build, validate, and git diff --check passed on this repaired candidate; controller rerun in progress
validation_boundary.compose_image_postgres: Controller reports Compose config, image build, private DB health, nonsuperuser app role, actual PostgreSQL migrate/submit/reconnect/get, and fresh isolated init-script bootstrap with repaired secret permissions passed. Those runtime checks are controller evidence and do not establish live HTTPS acceptance.

next_direction: Proceed with owner-authorized queue-only deployment validation after controller final gates; keep acceptance open until live TLS/session, restart persistence, isolated backup/restore, and pre/post inventory of the nine protected containers pass. Do not infer worker or full-product readiness.
